noodles/be06395:
renderOffline was a hand-copied fork of the signal chain, and it had
fossilized: the master section still carried the pre-rework glue
(ratio 6, limiter -1, hotter saturation, no +8 dB makeup), harmony and
melody preset gain trims were dropped, drum hits ignored their
velocities, and the pad filter LFO didn't exist offline. Exports were
a different mix than the app.

buildGraph() is now the only place the chain exists; the live context
and Tone.Offline both call it, and preset appliers plus the arrangement
step player are shared, so export-matches-app holds by construction.

Two divergences resolved in live's favor: drums keep bypassing the
per-track input compressor (the offline fork triple-compressed them),
and harmony presets now steer the pad cutoff by rescaling the LFO's
range around their filter value — a signal connected to a param
overrides it, so the old frequency.value writes were silently ignored
placebo (and rampTo on it throws).

Also gone: the dead toggle/setMode/device/setDevice API, the parallel
mute/solo state maps, and the never-applied per-kit swing fields.
site/bec1acf:
Downloading the two-top APK from the cabinet did nothing when activated
with the A button. The A button fires a synthetic el.click() on the
focused rail link, and mobile browsers block a programmatic click that
spawns a target="_blank" tab as a popup. A direct tap worked; the d-pad
plus A path, which is the primary input on a phone, silently failed.

Render a file download (an .apk href) same-tab with a download attribute
instead of target="_blank". The asset responds with
Content-Disposition: attachment, so a same-tab click downloads without
navigating away and no popup blocker is involved. Real web demos keep
target="_blank". Tests cover both.
